sections.text_helper: Section 23.8.1 "Comparator status register (COMP_SR)" in chapter 23 (Comparator (COMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 720.
sections.section_content:
The COMP_SR is the comparator status register.
Address offset: 0x00
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:18 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 17 C2IF: COMP2 channel interrupt flag
This bit is set by hardware when the COMP2 channel output is set.
This bit is cleared by software by writing CC12F = 1 in the COMP_ICFR register.
Bit 16 C1IF: COMP1 channel interrupt flag
This bit is set by hardware when the COMP1 channel output is set.
This bit is cleared by software by writing CC1IF = 1 in the COMP_ICFR register.
Bits 15:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 C2VAL: COMP2 channel output status bit
This bit is read-only. It reflects the current COMP1 channel output taking into account
POLARITY and BLANKING bits effect.
Bit 0 C1VAL: COMP1 channel output status bit
This bit is read-only. It reflects the current COMP1 channel output taking into account
POLARITY and BLANKING bits effect.
